asset.name: ConditionalField
asset.description: The schema-driven field that appears, disables, resets, or reconfigures itself based on a compiled dependency expression rather than ad hoc conditional rendering.

requires.reason: Values, validation, dirtiness, and submission live in the field-granular store rather than component state.

rationale: Compiled rather than evaluated per render: a form with fifty conditional fields re-evaluating every predicate on every keystroke is the common performance failure in generated forms.
